text: Process requested admin privileges or sudo access unexpectedly
action: Deny the request. Identify the process and terminate if unknown.
hygiene: Never grant admin privileges to unknown processes.

text: Unknown binary executed from /tmp or /var/tmp directory
action: Terminate the process immediately and delete the binary.
hygiene: Executables should never run from temp directories.

text: Script executed from downloads folder or user temp directory
action: Stop execution and scan the file with a trusted tool.
hygiene: Never run scripts downloaded from the internet without verification.

text: DNS query to known malicious domain or suspicious TLD like .ru .cn .tk
action: Block the connection and identify which process made the request.
hygiene: Use a DNS filter like NextDNS to block malicious domains automatically.

text: Outbound connection to IP address on known threat blacklist
action: Block the connection immediately and audit running processes.
hygiene: Enable firewall and monitor outbound connections regularly.

text: Unusual outbound traffic on non-standard port at night or off-hours
action: Block and investigate. Could be data exfiltration.
hygiene: Set up network monitoring alerts for unusual traffic patterns.

action: Check which process accessed the file and why. Terminate if unknown.
hygiene: System files should only be accessed by trusted system processes.

text: Mass file modification or encryption detected across multiple directories
action: Immediately disconnect from network and shut down. Possible ransomware.
hygiene: Keep offline backups. Ransomware cannot encrypt what it cannot reach.

text: Application accessed keychain or password storage without user prompt
action: Revoke app keychain access in System Settings immediately.
hygiene: Audit keychain access permissions for all installed apps regularly.

text: Browser visited domain that mimics legitimate service like paypal-secure or amazon-login
action: Close the tab immediately. Do not enter any credentials.
hygiene: Always check the exact domain in the address bar before logging in.

text: Pop-up claiming virus infection asking to call a number or download tool
action: Close immediately. Do not call any number or download anything.
hygiene: Legitimate security software never asks you to call a phone number.

text: Application accessed microphone or camera without user interaction
action: Check which app triggered this in System Settings > Privacy.
hygiene: Regularly audit microphone and camera permissions for all apps.

text: New browser extension installed from unknown or third party source
action: Review and remove the extension immediately if unrecognised.
hygiene: Only install browser extensions from official stores with high ratings.

text: Application attempting to modify system startup items or launch agents
action: Block and remove the launch agent from ~/Library/LaunchAgents.
hygiene: Audit launch agents regularly using tools like KnockKnock.

text: SSH login attempt or remote access request from unknown IP address
action: Block the IP and disable SSH if not actively needed.
hygiene: Disable SSH when not in use. Use key-based auth, not passwords.

text: System update check from apple.com or software update service
action: No action needed. This is normal system behaviour.
hygiene: Keep system updates enabled for automatic security patches.

text: iCloud backup or sync operation running in background
hygiene: Regular backups protect against data loss and ransomware.

text: Known application accessed its own data directory or app support folder
action: No action needed. Normal app behaviour.
hygiene: Keep apps updated to their latest versions.
